Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Voluntary signed and dated IRB/IEC approved written informed consent form in accordance with regulatory and local guidelines.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has obtained written informed consent, as explicitly stated in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Be 18 years or older and 80 years or younger on the day of signing consent.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is 47 years old, which falls within the specified age range of 18 to 80 years.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have a confirmed diagnosis of: - (GROUP A) De novo diffuse large B cell lymphoma that fails to achieve a PET negative complete response to primary rituximab and anthracycline based multi-agent chemotherapy and at least maintains stable disease after salvage chemotherapy or present double/triple hit features defined by overexpression by standard immunohistochemistry of c-MYC plus BCL2 and/or BCL6 or presence of chromosomal translocations as detected by break-apart FISH involving IGH/MYC plus IGH/BCL2 and/or IGH/BCL6 and who only received standard chemoimmunotherapy with rituximab, cyclophosphamide, vincristine and prednisone (R-CHOP) for induction and present at least stable disease after consolidation or salvage chemotherapy. Stable disease (SD) for lymphoma is defined in Appendix B: Lugano Classification for Response Assessment of Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, not diffuse large B cell lymphoma.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have a confirmed diagnosis of: - (GROUP B) Recurrent high-risk diffuse large B cell lymphoma defined as relapsing within one year of completion of rituximab and anthracycline based multi-agent chemotherapy or a sAAIPI (second-line age-adjusted International Prognostic Index) intermediate or high at relapse or acquisition of double/triple hit features upon relapse (as defined in group A) and at least stable disease after salvage chemotherapy. Patients with an initial diagnosis of low-grade/indolent non-Hodgkin lymphoma (i.e. follicular, marginal zone) who present relapse with histologic transformation to diffuse large B cell lymphoma (confirmed by biopsy) and meet the definition for high-risk as presented above, are also eligible.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's diagnosis is breast cancer, not diffuse large B cell lymphoma, and there is no mention of a relapse or transformation from another type of lymphoma.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have a confirmed diagnosis of: - (GROUP C) De novo high-risk T cell lymphoma with at least stable disease after primary therapy. High risk T cell lymphoma is defined as Stage III or IV disease at presentation and/or failure to achieve CR after frontline chemotherapy. Patients with ALK-positive ALCL will be excluded from the trial. Patients with ALK-negative ALCL in complete response will be excluded from the trial.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has breast cancer, not T cell lymphoma, and there is no mention of ALK status or response to therapy.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have a confirmed diagnosis of: - (GROUP D) Recurrent T cell lymphoma with at least stable disease after salvage therapy. Patients with ALK-positive ALCL will be excluded from the trial.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has breast cancer, not T cell lymphoma, and there is no mention of ALK status or response to therapy.
